listings.description: Human8e Ltd | Applied cryptographer, protocol review | REMOTE (worldwide) | Contract, fixed fee We're an early-stage UK company building a mobile application, funded by its founder (just me), which is why the scope below is deliberately narrow. I'm looking for an applied cryptographer to review a protocol specification before it ships. It is small and specific: three messages, two parties, signature-based, using hardware-backed keys on both iOS and Android. It uses standard primitives only (ECDSA over P-256, SHA-256) and invents no new cryptography; the question is how they are combined. The specification is written and frozen, with test vectors and the generator that produces them. What I want is a competent second opinion on whether it is sound: six specific questions answered in writing. Not an open-ended audit or a penetration test. The person I'm looking for has either published on protocol security or reviews protocols professionally; being good with crypto libraries isn't quite the same thing. One piece of contract work, not a role. Under a short mutual NDA. Email clive@human8e.com by Sunday 4 October with a short summary of the protocol analysis you've done, and I'll send scope, timing and what I'd need from you.

Moderne Büroarbeit erlebst Du bei uns direkt vom ersten Tag, denn mit Emma, unserer RPA-Lösung, und dem gezielten Einsatz von KI gestalten wir unsere Verwaltungsprozesse schlanker und schneller. In Deiner dreijährigen Ausbildung lernst Du alle Bereiche kennen, die ein Kanzleibüro am Laufen halten, und findest dabei heraus, was Dir im Sekretariat am meisten liegt. Oft bist Du der erste Kontakt, den Mandanten am Telefon oder am Empfang mit uns haben. Natürlich stehen Dir dabei immer Deine Kollegen zur Seite, die Deine Entwicklung fördern und Dir regelmäßig Feedback geben. listings.description: Unsere Story – gewachsen aus Überzeugung. Es gibt Überzeugungen, die bleiben und genau das macht uns aus. Was uns dabei leitet, ist bis heute dasselbe: Wir arbeiten nur mit Menschen zusammen, mit denen es wirklich passt, ob im Team oder mit unseren Mandanten. Denn gute Arbeit entsteht dort, wo Vertrauen herrscht, jede Stimme zählt und man gemeinsam Lösungen entwickelt. Diese Haltung macht uns aus und sie eröffnet Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich bei uns einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Deinen eigenen Weg in der Steuerberatung und in unserer Kanzlei zu gehen. As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

  • Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.

Wir machen die digitale Welt sicherer, indem wir Daten zuverlässig speichern und schützen. Mit unserem Bereich Memory Solutions adressieren wir anspruchsvolle Industrie- und Embedded-Märkte weltweit. Qualität, Verlässlichkeit und langfristige Kundenpartnerschaften stehen dabei im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung unserer marktorientierten Vertriebsorganisation im Bereich Memory Solutions schaffen wir eine neue, strategisch zentrale Rolle im Bereich Revenue Operations. Deine Mission Als Sales Operations Manager - Memory Solutions (MEM) stellst du sicher, dass unser zukünftiges Vertriebsmodell wirksam, transparent und skalierbar funktioniert. Du übersetzt das definierte strategische Zielbild in ein klares operatives Sales-Vorgehensmodell. Dazu gehören Prozesse, Rollen, Meetings, KPIs, Schnittstellen, Forecasting-Logiken, Deal-Desk-Mechaniken und transparente Steuerungsinstrumente. Im Mittelpunkt deiner Rolle steht die professionelle Vertriebsmechanik im Tagesgeschäft: klare Regeln, verlässliche Daten, saubere Prozesse, bessere Forecasts, höhere Deal-Disziplin und ein gemeinsames Verständnis darüber, wie Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Finance und Supply Chain zusammenarbeiten. Dein Ziel ist es, die Sales-Organisation von Memory Solutions in die Lage zu versetzen, fokussierter, verbindlicher, datenbasierter und skalierbarer zu arbeiten. Dabei berichtest du direkt an den General Manager der Business Division und bist auf Augenhöhe zu den verantwortlichen Peers im Vertrieb. Idealerweise bist du direkt oder überwiegend am Headquarter in Bronschhofen (CH) aktiv und damit eng an den genannten Schnittstellen. Spannende Aufgaben warten auf Dich Sales Operating Model : Teilhabe an Aufbau, Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Sales-Vorgehensmodells (z.B. Market Squads) inkl. Rollen

listings.title: Senior Web Compatibility Engineer
listings.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the latest — Privacy Pro . Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include: Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer , you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo. About You 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript. Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. A key part of the role will also be participation in our privacy review and audit processes, ensuring that all product developments align with our privacy principles. listings.description: If you're a driven sales professional with deep roots in the asset management sector and a passion for connecting clients to the data solutions they depend on, this is a rare opportunity to own and shape a high-growth territory across DACH and Central Europe. As Senior Business Development Manager, you'll take the lead on one of FE fundinfo's most strategically important regions, bringing our Dissemination & Distribution solutions to asset managers, fund promoters, platforms and data vendors across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe. This is a role where your market knowledge, client relationships and commercial instincts will directly influence product direction, go-to-market strategy, and the growth of a business that sits at the heart of the fund distribution ecosystem. You'll work alongside talented colleagues across sales, product and client success, with the backing of a dedicated BDR team and marketing function. Your key responsibilities as a Senior Business Development Manager will include: Owning and executing the sales strategy for our Dissemination and Distribution solutions across asset managers and fund promoters in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe. Driving pipeline growth and bookings through programmatic execution of the DACH and Central Europe go-to-market plan, including cross-sell and new name sales plays. Partnering with marketing and a dedicated BDR team to drive demand, and representing FE fundinfo at industry events across the DACH and Central European markets. Collaborating with Client Success Managers to deliver a seamless post-sales experience and with product teams to bring client insight into the roadmap. listings.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
listings.description: Join our mission We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster. About the role Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers. Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer. Our culture We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. listings.title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Basel
listings.description: Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Basel dein eigenes Netzwerk auf. Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen. Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise). Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann. Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss. Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt. Das bringst du mit Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit. Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort. Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken. Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn. Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln. Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools. Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein. Das erwartet

listings.title: Data selection and quality evaluation for biological foundation models
listings.description:
At Inceptive, you will help pioneer the next generation of AI-designed drugs, with the potential to positively impact billions of people, as part of a collaborative, antedisciplinary team.

We advance the state of the art in molecular design by training large-scale foundation models that enable cutting-edge generative approaches. Those models depend on rich, high-quality experimental data that captures biological function. Progress requires not only building better models, but also designing better experiments, understanding measurement systems, and generating datasets that faithfully represent underlying biology.

You will collaborate closely with biologists and machine learning researchers to design, analyze, and improve the experiments that power our models. You will help determine what data should be generated, how experiments should be structured, how measurement artifacts can be identified, and how biological insights can be translated into scalable data generation strategies.

Your Mission, should you choose to accept it

  • Embody our vision of an antedisciplinary environment and embrace learning about areas outside of your traditional area of expertise
  • Develop statistical and computational approaches to characterize assay quality, reproducibility, and sources of experimental variation
  • Identify and investigate sources of bias and measurement artifacts in biological datasets
  • Design and analyze large-scale biological experiments that generate training and evaluation data for machine learning models
  • Partner with experimental scientists to improve assay design, controls, and data collection strategies
  • Collaborate with machine learning researchers to understand how experimental design decisions impact model training and evaluation
  • Analyze, visualize, and communicate findings to support decision-making across scientific and engineering teams

listings.title: Computational design of biological experiments for model development
listings.description:
At Inceptive, you will help pioneer the next generation of AI-designed drugs, with the potential to positively impact billions of people, as part of a collaborative, antedisciplinary team.

We advance the state of the art in molecular design by training large-scale foundation models that enable cutting-edge generative approaches. Those models learn from diverse biological datasets and are refined through focused experimentation, large-scale training, and feedback from lab measurements. Progress depends not only on building better models, but also on understanding what they learn, where they fail, how data shapes their behavior, and how to evaluate them against biologically meaningful objectives.

You will collaborate closely with AI researchers and biologists to rigorously characterize the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of biological foundation models and their applications. You will identify valuable datasets, develop meaningful evaluations, investigate model behavior, and generate insights that guide model development, data strategy, and experimental priorities across the company.

Your Mission, should you choose to accept it

  • Embody our vision of an antedisciplinary environment and embrace learning about areas outside of your traditional area of expertise
  • Investigate how model performance changes with data quantity, data quality, dataset composition, and training methodology
  • Develop biologically meaningful evaluations and benchmarks that measure progress toward therapeutic design objectives
  • Design and execute rigorous experiments to understand the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of biological foundation models
  • Identify sources of potential artifacts, bias, and noise in biological datasets
  • Identify promising biological datasets for model training and evaluation, and develop computational pipelines for preprocessing, quality control, and exploratory analy
